rest_pose: Main and LOD lie supine; base is upright. Root X rotation -90 degrees lays the authored anatomy on its back.
description: Original dry, stylized human skeletal remains with removable weathered military equipment. No gore.
notes: Native free-model mesh assets with embedded material atlas.
Separate skull, mandible, torso, pelvis, limb and finger groups.
Equipment can be hidden by group; no national insignia.
No entity code, death events, ragdoll physics or universal skeleton generator is included.
Restants should be static; use the LOD and distance culling in the mod.
